purpose: Clarify the final comparison before selecting a policy or observing final results.
final_opponents_rule: Compare the selected policy with the other three declared policies; exclude an identical selected policy. Include legacy_ts as a fourth maintained-engine diagnostic control.
original_source_reference_protocol: Separate Kaggle same-host deployment check: two side-reversed pairs, preserved source and shipped Linux binary, original eight workers and 300-second internal budget. New selected agent eight workers, 300-second ceiling and five-second per-move cap. Both have external 300-second participant ceiling and 30-second response deadline. Time managers and randomness differ, so no RAVE-only causal claim or exact historic-match reproduction.
reason: The initial candidate list assumed RAVE-TS would be selected. Excluding self-comparisons and separating a diagnostic historical-statistic control keeps comparisons interpretable.
interpretation: New seeds are disjoint from development seeds. First-move coordinates may repeat across suites. Outcomes are conditional on these internal opponents, openings and CPU budgets.
